rationale: The training failures come from concurrent retry storms and timeouts shorter than valid slow responses. This standard shared burst-aware limiter uses the published quota mode, waits for responses, and retains a stable job-specific idempotency key. Relative scaled sleeps work with both clock implementations without interpreting loop.time(). Boundary margins and Retry-After handling are conservative; no validation results are assumed.
provenance: Live Codex proposal; replay is regression execution, not an autonomous model run.
